notes.capture: captureAgl * agl + missingHpPercent + bonus + (vulnerable ? captureVulnerable : 0), clamp 0..100
notes.levelUp: while xp >= level * levelXpMul and level < levelCap: xp -= level*levelXpMul; level++; maxHp+=levelHp; str/agl/spc += levelStat
notes.benchXp: lead full XP; other living party members floor(xp * benchXpShare)
notes.nature: on mint: +str/+agl/+spc from logic.json natures[i]; hardy is 0; stored in party slot byte 12
